emerging_watch: Watch whether Big Banks (ZEB.TO) narrows the rotation margin vs Oil & Gas (currently 1.393) toward zero AND its breadth/durability stays above 0.85/0.7 — that combination would signal a confirmed handoff rather than just a pullback in the leader; retire the watch if XEG.TO re-widens the margin back above 1.0 over the next 15 trading days.
